title: fix: accept UTC offsets in API key expiresAt updates
author: Connectslide121

gist.summary: PATCH /api/account/keys/:id now accepts expiresAt timestamps with UTC offsets, such as 2030-01-01T02:00:00+02:00, instead of returning 400. The value is converted with new Date() and stored as the equivalent UTC instant; timestamps ending in Z continue to work. An integration test covers the offset case.
